model.rationale: The district's eleven-point Democratic lean, Morrison's dominant fundraising advantage over a challenger with no money on file, and market pricing near 97 percent all align behind a safe Democratic hold. With no polls available, the forecast rests on these structural indicators and stays close to the fundamentals-based estimate.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a single-digit race or a sudden surge in challenger or outside spending would be the clearest sign the outlook is narrowing.

overview:
MN-03 covers Minneapolis's western suburbs and leans Democratic by about eleven points on recent partisan performance. Kelly Morrison, first elected in 2024, is running for re-election and has raised roughly $1.9 million, while Republican Tyler Bass shows no fundraising on file. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets price the Democratic chance near 97 percent.

Every available signal points the same direction: the district's lean, an incumbent with a dominant money advantage, and market pricing all favor Democrats. The race therefore rates as Safe Democratic, with the main caveat being the absence of polling to confirm the fundamentals. A late influx of challenger or outside spending would be the first sign of a competitive contest.
